title: PatchResult
description: The exact local candidate a software check runs against: the repository named by its root commits, the base commit, the candidate commit or working tree resting on a commit, and every changed path with the digest of its candidate content. It establishes that a typed candidate exists against the pinned base, nothing about its quality.

root_commits.description: Every parentless commit reachable from the candidate, sorted.

commit.description: The candidate commit, or the commit a working tree rests on.

patch_digest.description: Digest of the textual patch from the base to the candidate under pinned diff options; untracked files are identified through changes instead.

changes.description: Every path that differs between the base and the candidate, sorted by path.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, /-separated, as Git reports it.

content_digest.description: Digest of the candidate content; absent exactly for deletions.

size.description: Size in bytes of the candidate content; absent exactly for deletions.

commit.description: A Git object name: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.
